about.title: About AutoRent
about.lead: Locally owned car rental based in Prishtina, built for travellers and locals who want a car without the hassle.
about.p1: AutoRent started with a simple idea: renting a car should be as easy as booking a hotel room. Pick your dates, pay online, and collect the keys at our branch, with no paperwork surprises and no hidden fees.
about.p2: We keep a carefully maintained fleet, from city hatchbacks to family SUVs and vans. Every car is serviced on schedule, fully insured, and cleaned before each rental.
about.p3: Because we operate from a single location in Prishtina, we know every car we hand over, and we're here in person if you need anything during your trip.
about.value1Text: Every car is serviced on schedule and ready when you are.
about.value2Text: Clear, upfront pricing with no hidden fees, ever.
about.value3Text: A local team you can reach in person, before and during your trip.
about.locationText: We operate from a single location in the heart of Prishtina, so pick-up is quick and personal.
about.ctaText: Browse the fleet and book your car in minutes.

items.q: How do I book a car?
items.a: Choose your car and dates, add any extras, and pay securely online. Your booking is confirmed the moment payment goes through.
You pay in full online at the time of booking. There's nothing to pay at pick-up unless you add extras later.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: Yes. Cancel at least 48 hours before pick-up for a full refund. Cancellations after that receive a 50% refund, and no-shows are non-refundable.

items.q: What do I need at pick-up?
items.a: A valid driving licence, an ID or passport, and the card used for the booking. The driver must match the booking details.
Some cars require a refundable security deposit, shown on the car's page. It's released after the car is returned in good condition.

items.q: Where do I collect the car?
items.a: From our branch in Prishtina. The exact address and directions are in your confirmation email.

sections.b: All bookings are made online and paid in full at the time of booking. A booking is only confirmed once payment has been successfully processed.
The main driver must hold a valid driving licence held for at least one year and present a valid ID or passport at pick-up.
Cancellations made at least 48 hours before the pick-up time receive a full refund. Later cancellations receive a 50% refund. No-shows are non-refundable.
Vehicles must be used lawfully and returned in the condition they were provided, with the same fuel level. The renter is responsible for fines and tolls incurred during the rental.
All vehicles include basic insurance. A refundable deposit may apply and is released after the vehicle is returned undamaged.
AutoRent is not liable for personal belongings left in the vehicle or for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control.

In the event of an accident or breakdown, contact us immediately and, where required by law, the police. Do not admit liability at the scene. We will arrange assistance or a replacement vehicle where possible.

The vehicle is inspected together with the renter at pick-up and drop-off. Any damage beyond normal wear is assessed on return and may be charged against the refundable deposit; the remainder of the deposit is released within a few business days.

When you book, we collect your name, email, phone number, rental dates, and booking details. Payment card data is handled directly by our payment processor, Stripe, and is never stored on our servers.
We use your information to process bookings and payments, confirm and manage your rental, provide customer support, and send booking-related notifications.
Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. Your card details are transmitted securely to Stripe and are subject to Stripe's privacy policy. We receive only a payment confirmation and a token reference.
We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers needed to operate the rental (such as Stripe for payments) and where required by law.
We keep booking records for as long as needed to provide the service and to meet our legal and accounting obligations.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at the email on our Contact page.
Cancel at least 48 hours before the scheduled pick-up time and you receive a full refund of the amount paid.
Cancellations made less than 48 hours before pick-up receive a 50% refund of the amount paid.
If you do not collect the vehicle and do not cancel, the booking is non-refundable.
Approved refunds are returned to the original payment card via Stripe and typically appear within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank.
Any refundable security deposit is released after the vehicle is returned undamaged, separately from the rental refund above.
